metaDescription: CUSTOM+ takes your product from sketch to shipping container: industrial design, DFM, vetted factory production in China, AQL quality control, and logistics.

hero.headline: CUSTOM+ turns ideas into manufactured products
hero.subhead: The made to spec standard in product development

pulseLabel: From napkin sketch to shipping container

who.heading: Most "made in China" failures are a translation problem. We sit in that gap on purpose.
who.lead: Whether you're moving off a private label catalog, fixing a factory relationship that's drifting, or building your first fully custom product, every engagement gets one consistent team that reads CAD files and spec sheets for a living.

why.heading: The capability is real. So is the risk. We exist to hold the second part down.
why.lead: The deepest manufacturing base in the world, and the horror stories that exist alongside it. The risk was never the country: it's going in without vetting, without contracts, and without inspection standards.

collab.body: CUSTOM+ is new and building its bench. If you work in CAD, tooling, or on inspection floors in Guangdong or Zhejiang, introduce yourself.
